rationale: This 2004 trade-press news item reports on Ofwat's release of initial consultation proposals for market-opening guidelines, wholesale network access charges for new entrant suppliers, and dispute resolution penalties. It contains no empirical research or systematic synthesis (E05) and examines supplier network-access pricing rather than household or community water service access outcomes.
plain_vs_narrow_note: Both narrow and plain Criterion 2 readings result in exclusion because the record is a non-empirical trade news report on newly released regulatory consultation proposals (E05) and measures no household or community service access outcome.

evidence_quotes.quote: Ofwat takes first stab at competition rules
The limited competition ear-marked for water edged closer when Ofwat put out its initial proposals on guidelines to govern market opening.
The regulator invited views on its thoughts on the application process for new entrants, general and operational issues raised by competition, access charges and how disputes should be resolved.
